scope_note: Static analysis of application source only; no runtime customer records, credentials, surveys, interviews, test results, or deployment metrics were collected. Requirements describe observed implementation, with gaps separately identified.

roles.access: Passwordless QR scan or registered mobile-number lookup; account must be approved before purchasing. Customer routes commonly use a user_id request parameter rather than a verified customer session.
responsibilities: Select container, quantity, delivery or pickup, and payment method
View receipt, track order, edit or cancel a pending order
Submit feedback for a delivered order

roles.access: Username/password authentication through login.php and staff/check_auth.php; verified staff role in admin_users.
responsibilities: Assign active riders to approved paid delivery orders
Notify ready pickup customers and record collection
Create inventory items and adjust stock

roles.access: Username/password authentication and rider session checked by rider/check_auth.php; dashboard actions are scoped to the assigned rider.
responsibilities: View assigned deliveries and customer destination
Send delivery messages and delay notices

roles.access: Username/password authentication and database-verified admin role through admin/check_auth.php.
responsibilities: Create or edit staff and rider access; enable/disable portal logins
Review transactions, inventory, feedback, and reports
Configure water/container prices, points rate, enabled rewards, payment QR images, branding and account settings
Export customer/transaction/rider CSV and review activity logs

functional_requirements.requirement: Register a profile with full name, barangay, street/purok and unique Philippine mobile number; create a pending customer record and downloadable QR code.
Approve or deny customer registrations; block purchases while customer status is pending or denied.
Find an account by QR code data containing user_id or by normalized registered mobile number.
Select 2.5-gallon slim, 5-gallon slim, or 5-gallon round containers, new/customer-container choice, positive quantity, and delivery or self pickup.
Calculate total from configured water/container prices, PHP 10 delivery fee per ordered container unless a free-delivery reward applies, and PHP 5 discount per complete group of five containers.
Require a valid map destination pin for delivery; pickup orders store no delivery coordinates.
Reserve selected gallon stock when an order is placed; additionally reserve generic New Container stock for a new-container purchase; reject insufficient stock and record stock movements.
Allow one active non-reward order per customer; permit editing only the current pending order and release/re-reserve its inventory.
Select cash, GCash, or Maya. For wallet payment, collect a valid mobile number and JPG/PNG/WEBP proof image no larger than 5 MB; mark wallet payment processing for manual verification.
Review proof and mark payments paid or failed; synchronize payment records and transaction payment status. Staff verification can also approve a still-pending order after stock checks.
Approve pending orders after inventory availability checks or deny them with stock release; notify customer and award loyalty points upon approval.
Assign only an active rider to an approved and paid delivery order; reject rider assignment for pickup orders and send a rider notification.
Start only own approved assigned/pending delivery and complete only own on_way delivery; clear old location at delivery start.
Display order progress and rider location using periodically refreshed JSON data and map tiles; record location coordinates and update time.
Send delay reasons and a short optional note to customer notifications and the message conversation while the assigned delivery is on the way.
Exchange customer-rider messages for active assigned delivery orders and customer-station messages for active pickup orders, limited to 500 characters per message.
Notify customers that an approved pickup is ready and mark pickup collected, which sets delivered and paid statuses.
Cancel only a pending order that has not begun fulfillment; release reserved stock, store denial/cancellation reason, and flag a paid wallet payment refund_pending.
Submit a single one-to-five-star rating and optional comment for an approved delivered order.

Convert sufficient loyalty points into an enabled reward, record redemption and pending claim, have staff approve it, and mark physical reward released or consume approved free-delivery reward on the next eligible delivery order.
Apply a common 12-month loyalty cycle from installation anniversary, resetting balances on the first request on or after the reset date.
Provide inventory low-stock/out-of-stock summaries, item creation and stock-in/stock-out/exact adjustment with reason and movement log for staff; provide inventory oversight for administrator.
Manage customer approval, assigned portal roles and login access, staff accounts, rider accounts and rider active/inactive status.
Maintain prices, points rate, enabled rewards, system logo, GCash/Maya QR settings, profile and password settings.
Show operational totals, transaction history, payment totals, reward conversions, and customer feedback. Administrator can export users, transactions, and riders as CSV.
Poll and display account/order/assignment notifications; customer browser system notifications require permission and a supported secure browser context.

steps: Customer submits validated profile and mobile number
System rejects duplicate mobile number in main create_account.php flow
System encrypts sensitive profile fields, creates pending user, requests external QR image and stores it
Administrator approves or denies account
Customer locates profile using QR or mobile number
Purchase pages require approved account
Approved customer with no active order selects container, condition and quantity
Customer chooses delivery, pins destination, chooses cash/wallet and submits required proof
Server recalculates price and validates fields
Within database transaction, server locks and decrements selected gallon stock and optional new-container stock; consumes approved free-delivery reward if selected
System creates pending order and receipt; cash payment pending, wallet payment processing
Staff approves order and credits points, or payment verification first calls approval helper
Staff ensures paid status before assigning an active rider
Rider starts approved assigned order; delivery status becomes on_way
Browser GPS is shared and customer polls location/status; participants can message or rider can report delay
Rider marks delivered; customer can submit feedback and place another order
Customer selects pickup; delivery fee zero and no pin required
Stock reservation and pending order creation follow normal order path
Staff approval sets delivery_status ready_for_pickup
Staff sends ready notification and may reply to pickup messages
Staff records pickup_collected, setting delivery_status delivered and payment_status paid
Customer may submit feedback and start a new order

transitions: pending -> approved by staff approval or staff payment-verification path
pending -> denied by staff, insufficient-stock legacy approval, or allowed customer cancellation
order_status.note: Denied is also used to represent customer/staff cancellation; use cancellation_reason for meaning. Some staff denial code can affect an already-approved record; diagrams should illustrate the intended pending review path rather than claim universal guarded transitions.

transitions: customer cancellation of paid wallet pending order -> refund_pending
payment_status.note: Payment status is separate from order approval and fulfillment. No automatic wallet settlement/refund integration was found. Staff assignment code requires paid status even though some cash-payment wording says collect on delivery.

transitions: staff assigns rider -> pending with rider; rider UI labels this Assigned
assigned/pending with assigned rider -> on_way by rider
delivery_status.note: assigned and on_the_way appear as accepted legacy aliases; current staff assignment writes pending and current rider start writes on_way.

steps: Order approval credits quantity multiplied by configurable points_per_gallon setting (default 1)
Customer selects enabled reward and system checks balance
Points deducted immediately; zero-amount approved RWD transaction and pending reward claim recorded
Staff approves claim -> approved and customer notification
Physical/service reward is released by staff -> claimed; free_delivery is consumed by a subsequent delivery order -> claimed
reward.note: Rate uses ordered container count despite points_per_gallon setting name. Existing reward code bundle_fast_lane has inconsistent displayed title/description; do not invent a corrected business rule. Only free_delivery has demonstrated automatic checkout discount integration.

pricing.formula: total = quantity * (configured water price + new-container price when selected) + (delivery ? 10 * quantity : 0, waived by approved free_delivery claim) - 5 * floor(quantity / 5)
pricing.configured_defaults: Water: 2.5-gallon slim PHP 15; both 5-gallon sizes PHP 20. New container price PHP 20 for each size. These are fallback defaults and may differ from administrator-saved settings.

integrations.name: QR Server API
integrations.purpose: Generate downloadable customer QR image from submitted JSON profile data
integrations.limitation: External availability and network required; current QR payload includes personal fields, so do not claim QR data is encrypted/minimal.

integrations.name: jsQR
integrations.purpose: Decode camera/image QR data in customer browser

integrations.name: Leaflet and OpenStreetMap tiles
integrations.purpose: Display delivery pin, rider and customer destination on maps

integrations.name: Browser Geolocation API
integrations.purpose: Read and watch rider device position; optionally locate customer map pin
integrations.limitation: Depends on location permission, device signal and browser support; deployment normally needs a secure context. No separate vehicle GPS hardware or guaranteed background tracking is implemented.

integrations.name: GCash and Maya manual transfer workflow
integrations.purpose: Show configurable wallet QR details and accept uploaded proof
integrations.limitation: No payment gateway API, webhook, or automatic transfer verification demonstrated.

integrations.name: Browser notifications and service worker
integrations.purpose: Show alerts from polling while application is open
integrations.limitation: Not evidence of server push delivery while browser is closed.

integrations.name: CDN client libraries
integrations.purpose: Bootstrap, Font Awesome, fonts, Chart.js and mapping/scanner assets are externally loaded by relevant pages

limitations.finding: Source review does not establish that any study participants, interviews, baseline timing, usability survey or acceptance test has actually occurred.
limitations.documentation_action: State all research environment/respondent numbers, schedule dates and evaluation metrics as proposed or to be completed; never invent scores or sample sizes.

limitations.finding: Wallet verification is manual; no automatic gateway settlement or refund processing is implemented.
limitations.documentation_action: Describe GCash/Maya as manually verified payment proof workflows.

limitations.finding: Customer QR/mobile lookup and several user_id-based pages/endpoints do not establish a robust authenticated customer identity. Public api/delivery_tracker.php declares wildcard CORS and does not include a role-auth guard before location mutation or completion handlers.
limitations.documentation_action: Distinguish role controls present on staff/admin/rider pages from unverified API/customer authorization; do not assert comprehensive access-control/security certification.

limitations.finding: QR image generation sends JSON containing customer name/address/contact to an external QR service.
limitations.documentation_action: Mention external QR data boundary and use only synthetic/redacted records for screenshots.

limitations.finding: Location display uses latest browser coordinates and periodic polling; routing optimization, verified road-network ETA, geofencing and continuous background location are not demonstrated.
limitations.documentation_action: Use 'periodically refreshed live location' and make no route-optimization claims.

limitations.finding: Cash wording can mention collection on delivery, while current staff assignment requires paid status first.
limitations.documentation_action: Document implemented paid-before-assignment rule and identify cash collection policy for stakeholder clarification.

limitations.finding: Some reports sum approved transaction amounts rather than paid receipts; zero-value reward transactions remain in certain overall transaction counts.
limitations.documentation_action: Label these totals as approved-order sales and distinguish them from verified-payment collections; do not call all dashboard values net cash revenue.

limitations.finding: Only one active order per customer is allowed; physical/service voucher rewards require staff fulfillment; only free delivery is automatically applied at checkout.
limitations.documentation_action: Record these explicit boundaries in scope.

limitations.finding: Business operations do not show a native mobile application, offline synchronization, water-quality sensor integration, automated refilling machinery, payroll, supplier purchasing, multi-branch management or formal accounting ledger.
limitations.documentation_action: Do not imply these features are part of the reviewed implementation.

limitations.finding: Reward redemption balance deduction and claim logging are not enclosed in one database transaction in user/rewards.php. Denial flow does not demonstrate automatic reversal of already-credited points or consumed free-delivery rewards.
limitations.documentation_action: Treat concurrent redemption and cancellation compensation as verification/improvement scenarios, not proven guarantees.

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Register valid customer; retry duplicate mobile; approve pending account; verify blocked versus approved purchasing
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Unique pending profile and QR; duplicate rejected; only approved customer can purchase

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Compare three container sizes, new/existing containers, pickup/delivery and quantities 1, 5, 10
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Server totals agree with configured formula including stock requirement and quantity discount

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Attempt two overlapping purchases of the last unit; edit or cancel an existing pending order
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: No overselling and balanced inventory reservation/release log; verify concurrent active-order behavior

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Submit cash and wallet payment, invalid mobile, unsupported proof and proof over 5 MB; verify/reject valid proof
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Correct validation, pending/processing/paid/failed transitions and synchronized payment records

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Try rider assignment before approval, before payment, to inactive rider, and to pickup order; then perform valid assignment
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Invalid assignments rejected; approved paid delivery goes to active rider and produces notification

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Assigned and unrelated rider attempt start/complete in portal and API; test out-of-order transitions
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Only authorized assigned rider should update correct stage; record any API authorization failure as defect

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Allow/deny GPS permission; move rider position; disconnect network; inspect stale timestamp and recovered updates
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Accurate permitted location and meaningful unavailable/stale handling; measure update delay without inventing baseline

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Message assigned rider and station, test 500-character limit, ready notification and pickup collection
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Correct recipient/context and collection sets delivered/paid

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Attempt feedback before delivery and after delivery; resubmit same feedback
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: One valid one-to-five-star review per delivered order

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Approve order, verify earned points; redeem insufficient/sufficient balances and disabled reward; approve/claim reward; consume free-delivery reward; simulate annual reset in isolated test data
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Correct balance and claim state; no duplicate redemption or silent point loss; record concurrency/compensation defects

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Adjust stock, inspect minimum threshold; reconcile approved-order totals against payment totals and CSV export
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Correct inventory logs and separately explained report measures; export matches selected synthetic records

proposed_evaluation_scenarios.scenario: Check administrator/staff/rider access separation and customer direct-object/API authorization; exercise phone and desktop workflows
proposed_evaluation_scenarios.expected: Record achieved controls and gaps, usability task completion time, success rate and participant ratings after consent
